system_prompt: You are a careful engineer. Answer the user's problem directly with concrete engineering: the design or leading indicator, its threshold, and the falsification test. Respect every stated constraint verbatim. English only. Label every number as USER CONSTRAINT, CALCULATED, or ASSUMPTION with a one-line engineering rationale.
a1_answer:
DESIGN: Ultrasonic cleaning system integrated into the heat exchanger with transducers operating at 40 kHz and 100 W per plate

THRESHOLD: Maintain ultrasonic intensity above 2 W/cm² throughout all plate channels during operation

CALCULATED: This intensity level provides sufficient acoustic cavitation to disrupt biofilm formation and scale precipitation while maintaining energy efficiency

FALSIFICATION TEST: Compare heat transfer coefficients and pressure drops between control plates (without ultrasonic treatment) and test plates (with ultrasonic treatment) after 6 months of operation in the same water conditions. If the test plates show a heat transfer coefficient below 2500 W/m2K or pressure drop increase greater than 20% compared to initial values, the ultrasonic system fails to meet the requirement.
